Rule: per-success = sum of all KNOWN cost parts (model+review+retry, including failures/retries/reviews, counted once) / accepted. Any null part -> partial=true, never zero-filled (missing_reason required). accepted=0 -> per_success=null. Pair = same case_id+replicate+input_hash on both arms; arm is the sole pre-registered difference.
